title: 2-year postdoctoral position in modeling of microbial soil carbon cycling
institution: University of Copenhagen, Department of Biology
about: Two-year postdoctoral position in modelling of microbial soil carbon cycling at the Department of Biology, Faculty of Science, within the Center for Volatile Interactions (VOLT), which brings together ecosystem ecologists, microbial ecologists and ecosystem modelers.
